'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Tim Simon LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tim Simon]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Aylets
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
